blocks.text: Condo buildings in Langley
Streets, schools and transit near Langley condos

items.t: Scope: the board/SnapStats community "Langley," combining the Township and the City across eleven sub-areas: Aldergrove, Brookswood, Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley, Fort Langley, Langley City, Murrayville, Otter District, Salmon River, Walnut Grove and Willoughby Heights.
Community context: Langley Condos & Townhomes median $611,000, $513/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 25 days; detached median $1,345,000.

Condos and townhomes listed and sold in September 2026, by area: Willoughby Heights 369 listed, 70 sold (19%); Langley City 195 and 34 (17%); Walnut Grove 55 and 10 (18%); Murrayville 35 and 8 (23%, the highest rate but from few listings); Aldergrove 30 and 5 (17%); Fort Langley 9 and 1 (11%, very few listings).

SkyTrain: the Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension ends at Langley City Centre station; the Province states all eight stations along the 16-kilometre extension are under construction, with operation expected in late 2029.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Langley

items.t: The City and the Township have different rules. City buildings are under City of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 3300: suites are capped at 100 m² or 40% of the floor area, whichever is smaller, the owner must live on the property, and small-scale housing (Bylaw No. 3284, June 17, 2024) allows 4 units on RS1 and RS2 lots, or 6 within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Township buildings are under Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500: small-scale housing (Bylaw No. 6020, November 18, 2024) allows 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less and 4 on lots from 280 m² to 4,050 m², with no 6-unit option, and suites are capped at 120 m². None of these change an existing strata building's own bylaws.

blocks.text: Good to know about Langley condos

items.t: The combined median is at its 13-month low and still is not a condo price: the Condos & Townhomes median ranged from $611,000 (September 2026, the window low) to $725,000 (June 2026) across September 2025–September 2026 — a blended attached figure in every month.

Willoughby's Community Plan has a new frame to check: the Willoughby Community Plan was Bylaw 1836 (1979) and is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); the Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 only — never describe them as adopted or as having replaced the plan.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Langley
What Langley land means in this topic's frame

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default form for Langley land: A coach house is not a townhouse complex.

The R-CL small-lot rules (Township Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403) set a 220 m² minimum and 464.5 m² maximum lot area — there is no 355 m² figure in the bylaw, so a 355 m² R-CL cap is incorrect. That is a zoning fact about Township small lots, not an inventory of lots for sale.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and transit near Langley lots

items.t: Board identity: Langley is a Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB) community in the SnapStats data, with 11 sub-areas.

SkyTrain (Surrey Langley SkyTrain): the extension will end at Langley City Centre station; the Province's project reporting states all eight stations along the 16-kilometre extension are under construction, with the extension expected to enter operation in late 2029, extending the Expo Line from King George Station in Surrey to Langley City Centre.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Langley

items.t: Township plans and zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2500. The Willoughby Community Plan was Bylaw 1836 and is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); the Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 only — never describe them as adopted or as having replaced the plan.
Township SSMUH: Bylaw 6020 tops out at 4 units, with no 6-unit tier. The Township suite cap is 120 m². A Township coach house is a fee-simple unit under s.102 of Bylaw 2500, never strata.
Township of Langley R-CL small lots: Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403 (R-CL) = 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum lot area (no 355 m² figure).
City of Langley zoning and small-scale housing: Zoning Bylaw 3300. City suite cap = the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area, with the registered owner required to reside on the lot.

Strata checks (for the 22 strata buildings, and any bare-land strata lot): read the Form B (fees, amounts owing, levies, contingency reserve balance and insurance summary; provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page) together with the depreciation report and any special levies before you decide on a price. Since July 1, 2024, stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, and since November 1, 2023 at least 10% of the budget must go into the contingency reserve. Long-term rental restrictions have been void since November 24, 2022 (short-term rental limits can still apply). The only valid age bylaw is 55 and older, with exemptions for a younger spouse or partner, caregivers, existing residents and some children (May 1, 2023), so a "45+" listing line isn't an enforceable age limit.

Agricultural Land Reserve rules (for any Township property in the ALR; none of these buildings is): subdividing needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR homes can't be stratified. On ALR land, the main house can be up to 500 m², a suite is only allowed inside it, and an additional home can be up to 90 m² (186 m² on parcels over 40 ha).

Property transfer tax (a provincial tax, the same in the City and Township): 1% on the first $200,000, 2% up to $2 million, 3% above that, and another 2% on the residential part over $3 million. Examples: $500,000 → $8,000; $700,000 → $12,000; $800,000 → $14,000 ($6,000 for a first-time buyer who fully qualifies); $900,000 → $16,000; $1 million → $18,000; $1.2 million → $22,000; $1.5 million → $28,000; $1.8 million → $34,000; $2 million → $38,000; $3.5 million → $93,000.

Willoughby alone has more than half of Langley's condos and townhomes for sale: 369 of the 699 for sale (about 53%) in September 2026, so Langley-wide attached-home averages mostly reflect Willoughby (SnapStats, September 2026).

faq.a: No — separate municipalities, and the frames differ on every line that matters to a lot: Township Zoning 2500 with SSMUH 6020 (up to 4 units, no 6-unit tier; suite cap 120 m²) vs City Zoning 3300 by number with SSMUH 3284 (suite = lesser of 100 m² and 40%). Confirm the municipality on title before comparing anything.
faq.q: Are Langley City and the Township the same for lot rules?

faq.a: No. Township Bylaw 6020 has no six-unit tier: 3 units on lots of 280 m² or smaller, 4 units on lots up to 4,050 m². The 6-unit figure belongs to the City of Langley's Bylaw 3284, and only within 400 m of a frequent bus stop in RS1/RS2 — a different municipality's rule.

Willoughby, Latimer and Carvolth are also where much of the new condo building in the Township has happened.
